abstract: When designing product rankings, online retailers and platforms choose which outcome to maximize: revenues from commissions or markups, the number of transactions, or consumer welfare. These objectives need not align, creating potential trade-offs. This paper studies how rankings differ between objectives and quantifies the resulting trade-offs. I provide descriptive evidence showing that lower-priced and high-utility alternatives gain more demand when ranked higher, suggesting that ranking them higher increases transactions and consumer welfare but may decrease revenues. To quantify these trade-offs, I develop and estimate a structural demand model in which consumers search and discover products, and construct rankings for each objective. The results show that these counterfactual rankings all increase consumer welfare, transactions, and platform revenues relative to a neutral benchmark and the status quo and that trade-offs between these rankings are limited. This paper was accepted by Jean-Pierre Dube, marketing. Funding: R. P. Greminger received financial support from the Nederlandse Organisatie voor Wetenschappelijk Onderzoek [Research Talent Grant 406.18.568]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00782 .
abstract_zh: 在设计产品排名时，在线零售商和平台需选择最大化何种目标：来自佣金或加价的收入、交易数量，或是消费者福利。这些目标未必一致，从而可能产生权衡取舍。本文研究了不同目标下排名如何差异，并量化由此产生的权衡。我提供的描述性证据表明，价格更低且效用更高的替代品在被排名更高时会获得更多需求，这表明将其排名提高会增加交易量和消费者福利，但可能减少收入。为量化这些权衡，我开发并估计了一个结构性需求模型，其中消费者进行搜索并发现产品，同时为每个目标构建排名。结果显示，相对于中性基准和现状，这些反事实排名均能提升消费者福利、交易量及平台收入，且这些排名之间的权衡有限。本文已被营销领域的Jean-Pierre Dube接受。资助：R. P. Greminger获得了荷兰科学研究组织的研究人才资助[编号406.18.568]。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00782获取。
publisher: Institute for Operations Research and the Management Sciences (INFORMS)
title: Trade-Offs Between Ranking Objectives: Descriptive Evidence and Structural Estimation
title_zh: 排名目标之间的权衡：描述性证据与结构估计

abstract: This paper presents the multinomial logit model with repeated customer interactions. In each period, the same customer selects a product from the recommended assortment or opts out. From the seller’s perspective, the choice probability in the current period is updated based on the purchase history of the customer. We derive this conditional choice probability and study the adaptive assortment recommendation strategy. Although the problem is generally intractable, we discover the structures of the optimal assortment when the customer interacts with the seller for two periods and the available products to recommend are identical in the two periods. For a general number of periods, we find that the optimal fixed assortments that are not adapted to the purchase history can achieve 50% of the optimal expected revenue, and the approximation ratio increases to 68.47% when the available products across periods are disjoint. Using real-world data sets, we demonstrate that the model with repeated customer interactions can better predict the purchase behavior and generate higher revenues. This paper was accepted by Chung Piaw Teo, optimization. Funding: The authors gratefully acknowledge the funding support from Meituan. C. Wang’s research was supported by the National Science Foundation of China [Grants 72495133, 72172104] and China Postdoctoral Science Foundation [Grant 2025M780760]. P. Gao’s research was supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72522026, 72201234, and 72192805], Collaborative Research Funding [Grant C6032-21G] of the Hong Kong Research Grants Council, and the Guangdong Provincial Key Laboratory of Mathematical Foundations for Artificial Intelligence [Grant 2023B1212010001]. Y. Wang’s research was supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 12371513] and the Major Program of National Fund of Philosophy and Social Science of China [Grant 23&ZD135]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.02419 .
abstract_zh: 本文提出了考虑顾客重复交互的多项Logit模型。在每个周期内，同一顾客从推荐的商品集合中选择一件商品或选择退出。从卖方的角度来看，当前周期的选择概率会根据顾客的购买历史进行更新。我们推导了这一条件选择概率，并研究了自适应推荐策略。尽管该问题通常难以处理，但当顾客与卖方互动两个周期且两个周期内可供推荐的商品相同时，我们发现了最优商品集合的结构。对于一般周期数，我们发现不随购买历史调整的最优固定商品集合能够达到最优期望收入的50%，而当各周期可供商品不重叠时，近似比率提高至68.47%。利用真实世界的数据集，我们证明了考虑顾客重复交互的模型能更好地预测购买行为并产生更高的收入。本文由Chung Piaw Teo在优化领域接受。资助：作者感谢美团提供的资金支持。C. Wang的研究得到了国家自然科学基金[批准号72495133、72172104]和中国博士后科学基金[批准号2025M780760]的资助。P. Gao的研究得到了国家自然科学基金[批准号72522026、72201234和72192805]、香港研究资助局合作研究基金[批准号C6032-21G]以及广东省人工智能数学基础重点实验室[批准号2023B1212010001]的资助。Y. Wang的研究得到了国家自然科学基金[批准号12371513]和国家哲学社会科学基金重大项目[批准号23&ZD135]的资助。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.02419获取。

abstract: Theoretical research suggests internal information asymmetry (IIA) between top managers and divisional managers can reduce productivity by distorting internal resource allocation. The net effect, however, is unclear because IIA also reflects valuable private information within divisions, and empirical evidence is limited because of the unobservability of managers’ private information sets. Using a measure of IIA that exploits differences in returns to insider trading by top and divisional managers, we find that higher IIA is associated with lower total factor productivity. A one standard deviation increase in IIA corresponds to a 2.6% decrease in productivity relative to industry peers. This effect is comparable in magnitude to other important internal informational frictions, such as internal control weaknesses, and is distinct from internal information quality. Cross-sectional analyses indicate that the negative association is stronger when curative measures are limited and when agency conflicts between top managers and shareholders are greater. Mechanism tests indicate that IIA reduces internal capital market efficiency and increases underinvestment. Finally, using brokerage mergers and closures as a plausibly exogenous shock, we find that increases in IIA lead to declines in productivity. Overall, we provide empirical evidence that IIA is an economically important determinant of firm-level productivity. This paper was accepted by Jan Bouwens, accounting. Supplemental Material: The code and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08526 .
abstract_zh: 理论研究指出，高层管理者与部门管理者之间的内部信息不对称（IIA）可能通过扭曲内部资源配置而降低生产率。然而，由于IIA同时也反映了部门内部有价值的私有信息，其净效应尚不明确，且因管理者私有信息集合的不可观测性，实证证据有限。利用一种基于高层与部门管理者内幕交易收益差异来衡量IIA的指标，我们发现更高的IIA与更低的全要素生产率相关联。IIA每增加一个标准差，相对于行业同行，生产率下降2.6%。这一效应在规模上与内部控制缺陷等其他重要内部信息摩擦相当，并且与内部信息质量有所区别。横截面分析表明，当纠正措施受限以及高层管理者与股东之间的代理冲突加剧时，这种负相关关系更为显著。机制检验显示，IIA降低了内部资本市场效率并加剧了投资不足。最后，利用券商合并与关闭作为准自然实验冲击，我们发现IIA的增加导致生产率下降。总体而言，我们提供了实证证据表明IIA是企业层面生产率的重要经济决定因素。本文已被Jan Bouwens在会计学领域接受。补充材料：代码和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08526获取。
publisher: Institute for Operations Research and the Management Sciences (INFORMS)
title: How Important Is Internal Information Asymmetry for Firm-Level Productivity?
title_zh: 企业内部信息不对称对企业生产率的影响有多重要？

abstract: In prior publications, we introduced a global system of interconnected E-ledgers that produces—in as close to real time as practicable—accurate, comparable, and verifiable accounts of the cradle-to-gate (net) greenhouse gas emissions in any product or service that transacts in the economy. In this paper, we delve more deeply into the accounting infrastructure required for the E-ledgers system, including the specific journal entries for recording E-liabilities and E-assets. We explain how the E-ledgers of different entities in the economy articulate with each other and how they connect with jurisdictional E-ledgers that record emissions from end consumers. These entity and jurisdictional E-ledgers can be aggregated into a geological master ledger that tracks anthropogenic GHG emissions and removals, as debits and credits, to a geological carbon equity account. We also provide summary insights from computational technology and pilot studies to guide rapid and cost-effective E-ledgers deployment at scale. This paper was accepted by Shiva Rajgopal, accounting. Funding: Funding for R. S. Kaplan’s research was provided by Harvard Business School. K. Ramanna receives a salary from Oxford University. The authors are co-founders of E-ledgers Institute, a nonprofit organization, which seeks to implement the E-ledgers carbon accounting method in practice.
abstract_zh: 在先前的研究中，我们介绍了一个全球互联的电子分类账系统，该系统能够尽可能接近实时地生成经济中任何产品或服务从摇篮到大门（净）温室气体排放的准确、可比且可验证的账目。本文更深入地探讨了电子分类账系统所需的会计基础设施，包括记录环境负债和环境资产的特定日记账分录。我们解释了经济中不同实体的电子分类账如何相互衔接，以及它们如何与记录终端消费者排放的辖区电子分类账相连接。这些实体和辖区的电子分类账可以汇总成一个地质总分类账，以借方和贷方的形式追踪人为温室气体排放与清除，并计入地质碳权益账户。我们还提供了计算技术和试点研究的总结性见解，以指导大规模快速且成本效益高的电子分类账部署。本文由会计领域的Shiva Rajgopal接受。资金支持：R. S. Kaplan的研究由哈佛商学院提供资金支持。K. Ramanna从牛津大学领取薪水。作者是电子分类账研究所（一个非营利组织）的共同创始人，该组织旨在实践中推行电子分类账碳会计方法。
publisher: Institute for Operations Research and the Management Sciences (INFORMS)
title: E-ledgers Carbon Accounting
title_zh: 电子账簿碳核算

abstract: We investigate the theoretical mechanisms through which labor turnover adversely affects bank risk and performance. Using monthly matched employer-employee data from Brazil during 2003-2019, we find banks with higher labor turnover show lower risk buffers, greater loan losses, higher loan growth, and lower profitability. These adverse effects align with the firm-specific human capital theory. Consistent with our identifying assumptions, the effects are stronger when turnover reduces experience and expertise, among loan officers, as well as across cities and banks. Placebo tests and further analyses confirm our results. The evidence suggests that high labor turnover impairs bank information production, increasing risk and lowering performance.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了劳动力流动对银行风险与绩效产生不利影响的理论机制。利用2003-2019年间巴西月度匹配的雇主-雇员数据，我们发现劳动力流动率较高的银行表现出较低的风险缓冲、更大的贷款损失、更高的贷款增长以及较低的盈利能力。这些不利影响与公司特定人力资本理论相符。与我们的识别假设一致，当流动减少经验与专业知识时，在信贷员群体中，以及跨城市和银行间，这些效应更为显著。安慰剂检验及进一步分析证实了我们的结果。证据表明，高劳动力流动损害了银行的信息生产能力，从而增加了风险并降低了绩效。
title: Labor turnover, information production, and bank risk
title_zh: 劳动力流动、信息生产与银行风险

abstract: This paper studies the public expression of opinions on polarized topics (race and gender). In a series of pre-registered online experiments conducted in the United States in 2021 and 2023, we elicited participants’ views on these topics and their willingness to publish their views online. We find an asymmetric U-shaped relationship between ideological stance and willingness to share views publicly: moderates were least willing to speak up, willingness rose toward both ideological extremes and was highest among respondents with progressive views. Participants also perceived publicly expressed opinions as more left-leaning than underlying private opinions. A priming treatment highlighting the risk of negative social media backlash had modest and statistically insignificant effects. A social-information treatment informing respondents that many others were willing to speak up significantly reduced self-censorship.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了在极化议题（种族与性别）上公众意见的表达。通过2021年和2023年在美国进行的一系列预注册在线实验，我们收集了参与者对这些议题的看法及其在线公开发表意见的意愿。我们发现，意识形态立场与公开发表意见意愿之间存在不对称的U型关系：温和派最不愿发声，意愿向意识形态两端递增，且在持进步观点的受访者中最高。参与者还认为，公开表达的意见比私下意见更偏左。一项强调社交媒体负面反弹风险的启动处理效应较小且统计上不显著。一项告知受访者许多其他人愿意发声的社会信息处理显著减少了自我审查。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 249
title: Conformity and silence: Experimental evidence on social pressure and free speech
title_zh: 从众与沉默：关于社会压力与言论自由的实验证据

abstract: Why do so few women become CEOs? To understand this glass ceiling, we estimate a dynamic model of the CEO gender decision, which contains perceived gender productivity differences, search costs reflecting limited female labor supply, and employer disutility from discrimination. The key factor is the shortage of suitable female candidates, as boards prefer hiring women, and productivity differences between genders are minimal. We find no evidence of a glass cliff in which women become CEOs just as firms are failing. While better governance is associated with women becoming CEOs, the importance of limited female labor supply is unrelated to governance.
abstract_zh: 为何女性CEO如此稀少？为探究这一“玻璃天花板”现象，我们构建了一个CEO性别决策的动态模型，该模型涵盖了感知到的性别生产力差异、反映女性劳动力供给有限的搜寻成本，以及雇主因歧视而产生的负效用。关键因素在于合适女性候选人的短缺，因为董事会倾向于聘用女性，且两性间的生产力差异微乎其微。我们未发现“玻璃悬崖”的证据，即女性在企业濒临失败之际出任CEO的情况。尽管更优的公司治理与女性出任CEO相关，但女性劳动力供给有限的重要性与治理无关。
title: Underrepresentation of Women CEOs
title_zh: 女性CEO代表性不足问题研究

abstract: Forests play a vital role in maintaining ecosystem services and sustaining human livelihoods. However, under globalization, trade has increasingly exerted pressure on forest resources. Existing studies on deforestation footprints and forest-related incomes often overlook spatial heterogeneity and consistency, making it difficult to provide detailed information for precise land-use management policies. To address this gap, we develop an enhanced spatial input-output models by incorporating export-priority zones to construct 1 km-resolution deforestation footprint maps, which are then used to estimate forest-related incomes. Our findings reveal noticeable spatial heterogeneity in deforestation footprints within countries, with inland areas typically show lower deforestation footprints than coastal regions. Conventional country-level analyses overlook these details, often overestimating forest product incomes in inland regions (e.g., approximately 10% in the USA), while underestimating incomes in developed coastal regions (e.g., approximately 15% in China). Within 300 km of the coastlines, forest incomes are consistently underestimated, while more remote areas show the opposite bias. The pixel-level analyses in this study reveal statistically significant differences in forest product incomes within countries (p < 0.05), with inequality amplified by uneven locational advantages and different levels of economic development. These findings demonstrate that trade intensifies spatial inequalities in forest-based livelihoods. Policymakers should prioritize investments in infrastructure and market accessibility to reduce these disparities and promote more equitable and sustainable forest management.
abstract_zh: 森林在维持生态系统服务和保障人类生计方面发挥着至关重要的作用。然而，在全球化背景下，贸易对森林资源的压力日益增大。现有关于毁林足迹和森林相关收入的研究往往忽视了空间异质性与一致性，难以为精准的土地利用管理政策提供详细信息。为弥补这一不足，我们通过引入出口优先区，构建了增强型空间投入产出模型，生成了1公里分辨率的毁林足迹图，并据此估算森林相关收入。研究结果显示，各国国内的毁林足迹存在显著的空间异质性，内陆地区的毁林足迹通常低于沿海地区。传统的国家层面分析忽视了这些细节，往往高估内陆地区的森林产品收入（例如，美国约为10%），而低估发达沿海地区的收入（例如，中国约为15%）。在海岸线300公里范围内，森林收入始终被低估，而更偏远地区则呈现相反的偏差。本研究的像元级分析揭示了国内森林产品收入存在统计学上显著的差异（p < 0.05），且这种不平等因区位优势不均和经济发展水平差异而进一步加剧。这些发现表明，贸易加剧了森林生计的空间不平等。政策制定者应优先投资于基础设施建设和市场可达性，以缩小这些差距，促进更加公平和可持续的森林管理。

title: High-resolution mapping of global deforestation footprints and livelihood inequalities: Toward equitable forest governance
title_zh: 全球毁林足迹与生计不平等的高分辨率制图：迈向公平的森林治理

abstract: This paper examines whether patent-backed financing reforms affect firms’ external technology acquisition strategies. Using the staggered rollout of China’s Patent Pledge Financing Pilot (PPFP) across cities, we employ a difference-in-differences design to study its effect on corporate venture capital (CVC) investment. We find that PPFP significantly increases firms’ CVC activity, with the effect concentrated in high-tech CVC, and weaker for state-owned enterprises. These findings are consistent with the view that increasing the financial value of patent assets strengthens firms’ incentives to engage in technology-oriented CVC for external technology sourcing.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了专利质押融资改革是否影响企业的外部技术获取策略。利用中国专利质押融资试点（PPFP）在城市层面的分阶段推行，我们采用双重差分设计研究其对企业风险投资（CVC）的影响。研究发现，PPFP显著提升了企业的CVC活动，且该效应集中于高科技CVC，对国有企业的影响较弱。这些发现与提高专利资产金融价值会增强企业通过技术导向型CVC进行外部技术获取的动机这一观点相符。

title: When Patents Become Collateral: Intellectual Property Financialization and Corporate Venture Capital Investment
title_zh: 当专利成为抵押品：知识产权金融化与企业风险投资

abstract: This note revisits the standard derivation of the asymptotic unbiasedness of Akaike information criterion (AIC). The existing literature has shown that AIC is an asymptotically unbiased estimator of the predictive risk. However, there is a technical issue in these justifications. In this note, we bridge the gap and establish the asymptotic unbiasedness of AIC under certain regularity conditions, which are applicable in various scenarios. Our result suggests that AIC should be used with caution if the moment conditions on the parameter estimators may not hold. When model misspecification is allowed, our result can be extended to Takeuchi information criterion (TIC).
abstract_zh: 本注文重新审视了赤池信息准则（AIC）渐近无偏性的标准推导过程。现有文献已表明，AIC是预测风险的一个渐近无偏估计量。然而，这些论证中存在一个技术性问题。在本注文中，我们弥合了这一差距，并在一定的正则条件下确立了AIC的渐近无偏性，这些条件适用于多种情境。我们的结果表明，若参数估计量的矩条件可能不成立，则应谨慎使用AIC。当允许模型误设时，我们的结果可推广至竹内信息准则（TIC）。
title: A note on the asymptotic unbiasedness of Akaike information criterion
title_zh: 关于赤池信息准则渐近无偏性的注记

abstract: Rural-urban income inequality (RUIE) remains a persistent challenge across many rapidly developing regions, undermining socio-economic welfare and hindering sustainable development. The ecological transition of cropland use (ETCU), a management paradigm rooted in the principles of sustainable intensification, is widely advocated to enhance agricultural sustainability. While localized case studies suggest that such practices can bolster rural incomes through improved resource efficiency or product diversification, robust empirical evidence on whether large‑scale ETCU adoption mitigates regional RUIE remains scarce, and the underlying systemic mechanisms are poorly understood. This study develops a multi-scale "cropland-agriculture-rural" framework to analyze how ETCU influences RUIE in China's intensively cultivated Huang-Huai-Hai Region. By integrating plot-scale biogeochemical modeling (PEST-DNDC), county-level panel data (2000–2020), and Structural Equation Modeling, we systematically quantify the spatiotemporal patterns and causal pathways of this transition. The results demonstrate that: (1) ETCU and RUIE exhibit spatially heterogeneous co-evolution; improvements in ETCU are not consistently associated with reduced inequality, and in some coastal counties, they even coincide with widening gaps. (2) ETCU affects RUIE primarily by restructuring agricultural multifunctionality, which serves as the core mediator. (3) The effects are highly dimension-specific. Enhancing resource-use efficiency exerts a modest yet significant direct mitigating effect on RUIE. Conversely, improvements in productivity and environmental performance exhibit no direct effect; instead, they indirectly exacerbate inequality by weakening the agricultural product supply function—which our model identifies as a strong and direct suppressor of RUIE. The economic value-added and ecological conservation functions do not exhibit significant direct equalizing effects. These findings indicate that the equity outcomes of ETCU are not automatic but depend critically on how it reshapes the multifunctional structure of agriculture. Policy interventions must therefore adopt an integrated approach that strategically guides the agricultural transition toward balanced multifunctionality, safeguards diversified production, and ensures that efficiency gains translate into broadly shared benefits for both rural and urban households.
abstract_zh: 城乡收入不平等（RUIE）在许多快速发展的地区依然是一个持续存在的挑战，削弱了社会经济福祉并阻碍了可持续发展。耕地利用生态转型（ETCU）作为一种根植于可持续集约化原则的管理范式，被广泛倡导以提升农业可持续性。尽管局部案例研究表明，此类实践可通过提高资源效率或产品多样化来增加农村收入，但关于大规模ETCU采纳是否缓解区域RUIE的稳健实证证据仍然稀缺，其潜在的系统性机制也尚不明确。本研究构建了一个多尺度“耕地—农业—农村”框架，以分析ETCU如何影响中国集约化耕作的黄淮海地区的RUIE。通过整合地块尺度生物地球化学模型（PEST-DNDC）、县级面板数据（2000—2020年）以及结构方程模型，我们系统量化了这一转型的时空格局与因果路径。结果表明：（1）ETCU与RUIE呈现出空间异质的协同演化；ETCU的改善并非始终与不平等缩小相关联，在某些沿海县甚至伴随着差距扩大。（2）ETCU主要通过重构农业多功能性来影响RUIE，后者构成核心中介变量。（3）其效应具有高度维度特异性。资源利用效率的提升对RUIE产生适度但显著的直接缓解作用。相反，生产力与环境绩效的改善并无直接效应；而是通过削弱农产品供给功能间接加剧不平等——我们的模型识别出该功能是RUIE的强直接抑制因素。经济附加值功能与生态保育功能未表现出显著的直接均等化效应。这些发现表明，ETCU的公平结果并非自动实现，而是关键取决于其如何重塑农业的多功能结构。因此，政策干预必须采取综合路径，战略性地引导农业转型走向均衡的多功能性，保障多样化生产，并确保效率提升转化为城乡家庭广泛共享的福祉。

title: Can the ecological transition of cropland use narrow rural-urban income inequality? Evidence from China’s Huang-Huai-Hai Region
title_zh: 耕地利用生态转型能否缩小城乡收入差距？——来自中国黄淮海地区的证据

abstract: Road infrastructure is widely recognized as a driver of economic development, but can it also aid in disaster resilience? This study addresses the resilience question in the Indian context by examining the output effects of dual and staggered treatments: national highway construction – the Golden Quadrilateral, and the North-South and East-West highways – and extreme flood exposure. Employing a production-theoretic framework, this study focuses on India’s informal manufacturing, the largest in the world without any formal safety nets. It combines geospatially matched, staggered flood exposure data from the Dartmouth Flood Observatory with phased highway rollout timelines from the National Highways Authority of India and repeated cross-section plant-level survey data (1990–2016). Exploiting quasi-random variation in the timing of flood exposure and road construction, a stacked difference-in-differences design is implemented, matching treated districts to future-treated counterparts. Results show that floods significantly reduce gross output and value added, while access to completed highway segments nearly offsets the average 8 percent flood-related output loss through higher output and reduced input expenditures. These effects are magnified for plants that own transport assets, highlighting a complementarity between internal logistics and external infrastructure. Off-highway plants exhibit similar resilience only when they possess transport assets. Heterogeneity analysis by market orientation reveals that resilience benefits are higher among non-tradable industries through local market stabilization. These findings reveal that roads are not only engines of development but also critical to disaster resilience. Designing infrastructure with dual function—development and resilience—is essential for building a climate-smart and resilient economy.
abstract_zh: 公路基础设施被广泛认为是经济发展的驱动力，但它是否也能有助于灾害韧性？本研究通过考察双重且交错处理的产出效应来探讨印度背景下的韧性议题：国家公路建设——黄金四边形，以及南北和东西高速公路——与极端洪水暴露。采用生产理论框架，本研究聚焦于印度非正规制造业，这是全球最大的缺乏任何正式安全网的部门。研究将达特茅斯洪水观测站的地理空间匹配、交错洪水暴露数据与印度国家公路管理局的分阶段公路铺设时间线以及重复横截面企业层面调查数据（1990-2016年）相结合。利用洪水暴露和公路建设时间上的准随机变异，实施堆叠双重差分设计，将处理地区与未来处理的对照组进行匹配。结果表明，洪水显著降低了总产出和增加值，而通达已建成高速公路路段几乎抵消了平均8%的洪水相关产出损失，其机制是通过提高产出和减少投入支出。这些效应对于拥有运输资产的企业更为显著，凸显了内部物流与外部基础设施之间的互补性。不在公路沿线的企业仅在拥有运输资产时才表现出类似的韧性。按市场导向进行的异质性分析显示，非贸易行业通过本地市场稳定获得的韧性收益更高。这些发现表明，公路不仅是发展的引擎，也是灾害韧性的关键。设计兼具发展与韧性双重功能的基础设施，对于建设气候智慧和韧性经济至关重要。
title: Road to Resilience: Floods, Highways and Indian Informal Manufacturing
title_zh: 通往韧性之路：洪水、公路与印度非正规制造业

abstract: This paper examines how the US-China trade war reshaped supply chains across the Asia-Pacific region. Using newly constructed product-level input–output linkages from Chinese customs transactions, we trace how US tariffs on downstream Chinese exports propagated across borders and production stages. We document that US tariffs significantly reduced Chinese exports to the US and, through upstream linkages, caused a 6.8% decline in China’s imports from Japan, South Korea, and Taiwan. Furthermore, both China and the US reoriented parts of their supply chains toward alternative economies, especially ASEAN, but also Mexico and India. A quantitative Armington model shows that these adjustments generated heterogeneous welfare effects across countries: downstream economies such as ASEAN, Mexico, and India gained, whereas upstream suppliers such as Taiwan and South Korea incurred losses. We further show that, under a broader 2025 tariff escalation with retaliation, world trade contracts and welfare declines in all countries.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了中美贸易战如何重塑亚太地区的供应链格局。利用中国海关交易数据构建的全新产品层面投入产出关联，我们追溯了美国对中国下游出口商品加征关税如何跨越国界与生产阶段进行传导。研究发现，美国关税显著减少了中国对美出口，并通过上游关联效应，导致中国从日本、韩国及台湾地区的进口下降了6.8%。此外，中国与美国均将部分供应链转向其他经济体，尤其是东盟国家，同时也包括墨西哥和印度。一个量化的阿明顿模型显示，这些调整在不同国家间产生了异质性的福利效应：下游经济体如东盟、墨西哥和印度获益，而上游供应方如台湾和韩国则遭受损失。我们进一步表明，在2025年更广泛的关税升级及报复措施情境下，全球贸易收缩，所有国家的福利均出现下降。

title: Reshaping factory Asia: How did the US-China trade war affect the Asian-Pacific supply chain?
title_zh: 重塑工厂亚洲：中美贸易战如何影响亚太供应链？

abstract: As a central bank-backed digital financial infrastructure innovation, central bank digital currency (CBDC) may reshape the information and transaction environment of corporate financing in the digital economy. Using A-share firms listed on China’s SME Board from 2011 to 2024 as the research sample, this study employs a multi-period difference-in-differences model to examine the impact of China’s digital yuan pilot programme on the financing constraints of small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and its underlying mechanisms. The results show that the digital yuan pilot programme significantly alleviates financing constraints among SMEs. Mechanism analyses indicate that the digital yuan reduces financing constraints by improving corporate information disclosure quality and lowering financing transaction costs. Further analyses reveal that digital inclusive finance and corporate digital transformation strengthen the alleviating effect of the digital yuan. Heterogeneity tests show that the effect is more pronounced among non-state-owned enterprises and high-tech firms. Moreover, the alleviation of financing constraints contributes to improvements in corporate innovation efficiency and total factor productivity. This study extends the literature on the economic consequences of CBDCs by providing micro-level evidence from corporate financing and offers policy implications for enhancing SME financing environments and promoting the development of digital currency infrastructure. KEYWORDS: Digital yuan financing constraints information disclosure quality financing transaction costs digital inclusive finance corporate digital transformation JEL CLASSIFICATION: G21 G28 O16
abstract_zh: 作为央行背书的数字金融基础设施创新，央行数字货币（CBDC）可能重塑数字经济中企业融资的信息与交易环境。本研究以2011至2024年中国中小板A股上市公司为研究样本，采用多期双重差分模型，考察中国数字人民币试点项目对中小企业融资约束的影响及其内在机制。研究结果表明，数字人民币试点项目显著缓解了中小企业的融资约束。机制分析显示，数字人民币通过提升企业信息披露质量和降低融资交易成本来缓解融资约束。进一步分析发现，数字普惠金融和企业数字化转型强化了数字人民币的缓解效应。异质性检验表明，该效应在非国有企业和科技型企业中更为显著。此外，融资约束的缓解有助于提升企业创新效率和全要素生产率。本研究拓展了关于CBDC经济后果的文献，提供了来自企业融资层面的微观证据，并为改善中小企业融资环境、推动数字货币基础设施建设提供了政策启示。关键词：数字人民币；融资约束；信息披露质量；融资交易成本；数字普惠金融；企业数字化转型 JEL分类号：G21 G28 O16

title: Central bank digital currency and financing constraints of small and medium-sized enterprises: evidence from China’s digital yuan pilot programme
title_zh: 央行数字货币与中小企业融资约束：来自中国数字人民币试点项目的证据

abstract: This paper develops a Romer (1990)‐type endogenous growth model that incorporates polluting non‐renewable resources and heterogeneous households with varying asset holdings. It contributes to the literature on the taxation of polluting exhaustible resources by examining its impact on consumption inequality, with particular emphasis on the role of natural resources as household assets. In the model, the stock of pollution—accumulating through resource use—affects social welfare. We show that, when distortions from intertemporal knowledge spillovers are not fully corrected, environmental tax policies that slow resource extraction and mitigate the welfare costs of pollution can foster economic growth but exacerbate consumption inequality. To promote growth and reduce the welfare damage caused by pollution without increasing inequality, environmental tax revenues should be allocated for redistributive purposes. Lastly, the paper calibrates the model for quantitative analysis and explores environmental tax policies that maximize social welfare under limited government capacity to correct knowledge spillover distortions, relying on environmental tax revenues for redistribution.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个罗默（1990）式内生增长模型，该模型融入了污染性不可再生资源及资产持有量各异的异质性家庭。本文对污染性可耗竭资源税收研究领域的贡献在于，考察了此类税收对消费不平等的影响，特别强调了自然资源作为家庭资产的作用。在模型中，通过资源使用累积的污染存量影响社会福利。我们证明，当跨期知识溢出的扭曲未被完全纠正时，减缓资源开采并减轻污染福利成本的环境税收政策虽能促进经济增长，却会加剧消费不平等。为在不加剧不平等的前提下促进增长并减少污染造成的福利损害，环境税收收入应被用于再分配目的。最后，本文对模型进行了校准以进行定量分析，并探讨了在政府纠正知识溢出扭曲能力有限、依赖环境税收收入进行再分配的情况下，能够最大化社会福利的环境税收政策。
title: Taxing polluting resources: growth, welfare and consumption inequality
title_zh: 对污染性资源征税：增长、福利与消费不平等

abstract: A solution concept for two-person zero-sum games is proposed with only the axiom of Independence assumed of players’ preferences. Each player is shown to admit a set of admissible strategies assuring minimum guarantees. Rationality requires agents to reject non-admissible strategies in further considerations. Knowledge assumptions imply iterated elimination of non-admissible strategies resulting in surviving sets whose Cartesian product form consideration equilibria which is nonempty and includes any Nash equilibrium, if one exists. It coincides with the set of Nash equilibria or minimax strategy tuples if preferences additionally satisfy Continuity. Further, consideration equilibria of a game are contained in the set of minimax strategy tuples of the continuous approximation of the given game.
abstract_zh: 针对两人零和博弈，提出了一种仅假设玩家偏好满足独立性公理时的解概念。每位玩家被证明拥有一组确保最低收益保证的可接受策略。理性要求参与者在进一步考虑中排除非可接受策略。知识假设意味着对非可接受策略进行迭代剔除，最终存活的策略集合的笛卡尔积构成考虑均衡，该均衡非空，并且若存在纳什均衡，则包含所有纳什均衡。若偏好额外满足连续性，则该均衡与纳什均衡集或极小极大策略组合集一致。此外，博弈的考虑均衡包含于给定博弈的连续逼近的极小极大策略组合集中。
title: Two-person zero-sum games without expected utility preferences: a proposal
title_zh: 无期望效用偏好下的两人零和博弈：一个提议

abstract: Monetary policy is usually evaluated through its effect on aggregate output and inflation, with less attention to how it reallocates innovative investment across firms. Existing evidence shows that higher rates reduce innovation, but the firms driving this response remain unclear. Combining Norway’s R&D survey with administrative data and narrative monetary shocks for 2001–2018, we estimate heterogeneous firm responses. Contractionary policy reduces R&D most in high-growth firms with recent equity issuance, consistent with asset-price channels of monetary transmission. Standard debt-based measures explain little heterogeneity. Monetary policy therefore has long-run real effects primarily through its effects on R&D in high-growth firms.
abstract_zh: 货币政策通常通过其对总产出和通货膨胀的影响来评估，而较少关注其如何在企业间重新配置创新投资。现有证据表明，较高的利率会减少创新，但驱动这一反应的企业类型尚不明确。结合挪威的研发调查、行政数据以及2001-2018年间的叙事性货币冲击，我们估计了企业的异质性反应。紧缩性政策对近期有股权发行的高增长企业的研发削减最为显著，这与货币传导的资产价格渠道相符。基于债务的标准指标对异质性的解释力有限。因此，货币政策主要通过其对高增长企业研发的影响产生长期实际效应。
title: Monetary Transmission to Firm-level R&D
title_zh: 货币政策传导对企业层面研发的影响

abstract: We hypothesize that polygyny acts as a significant push factor for migration in sub-Saharan Africa because it is associated with competition within polygynous families and on the marriage market, while also contributing to unfavorable economic and political outcomes at the societal level. Using cross-country data from 46 sub-Saharan African countries, we show that higher polygyny prevalence is associated with increased international emigration. We complement this macro-level evidence with original survey data from Senegal, the Gambia, and Nigeria. We show that polygyny is also associated with higher migration aspirations and observed migration of survey respondents’ siblings at the individual level. Respondents from polygynous families tend to report stronger economic motives for migration, while those concerned about the marriage market effects of polygyny—regardless of family background—are more likely to consider migrating for marriage. This highlights two distinct pathways—competition within polygynous families and on marriage markets—linking polygyny to migration.
abstract_zh: 我们假设，在撒哈拉以南非洲，一夫多妻制作为迁移的重要推动因素，因其与多妻家庭内部及婚姻市场上的竞争相关，同时也在社会层面导致不利的经济和政治后果。利用来自46个撒哈拉以南非洲国家的跨国数据，我们显示，一夫多妻制的普遍程度越高，国际移民外流越多。我们以来自塞内加尔、冈比亚和尼日利亚的原始调查数据补充这一宏观层面的证据。我们表明，在个体层面，一夫多妻制也与更高的迁移愿望及调查对象兄弟姐妹的实际迁移相关。来自多妻家庭的受访者倾向于报告更强的经济迁移动机，而那些担忧一夫多妻制对婚姻市场影响的人——无论家庭背景如何——更可能考虑为婚姻而迁移。这凸显了将一夫多妻制与迁移联系起来的两种不同路径：多妻家庭内部的竞争和婚姻市场上的竞争。
title: Polygyny as a determinant of migration
title_zh: 一夫多妻制作为迁移的决定因素

abstract: In recent decades, economists studying international trade have gained access to an unprecedented volume and variety of data. These data have provided new insights and a more granular understanding of the mechanics of trade. Analyzing a large corpus of papers, we document that the nature of research has also shifted. Previously, the typical trade paper was either purely theoretical or an empirical paper testing theoretical predictions. More recently, scholarship has shifted toward a more integrated approach, particularly quantitative modeling. This development is surprising. We might have expected the data revolution (and contemporaneous credibility revolution) to increase the share of primarily empirical papers—although the markers of these revolutions are clearly evident in the rise of causal inference within empirical work. This article reviews these developments, assessing the strengths and limitations of different modes of inquiry, and plotting a path forward to harness the growing richness of data within the field.
abstract_zh: 近几十年来，研究国际贸易的经济学家得以接触到前所未有的海量且多样化的数据。这些数据为理解贸易机制提供了新的洞见和更为精细的视角。通过分析大量论文，我们发现研究性质也发生了转变。以往，典型的贸易论文要么是纯理论性的，要么是检验理论预测的实证研究。而近年来，学术界更倾向于采用一种更为综合的方法，尤其是定量建模。这一发展出乎意料。我们或许会预期，数据革命（以及同时期的可信度革命）会提高以实证为主的论文比例——尽管这些革命的标志在实证研究中因果推断的兴起中显而易见。本文回顾了这些发展，评估了不同研究模式的优势与局限，并规划了在该领域内利用日益丰富数据的未来路径。
title: The Data Revolution, and It's Uses, in International Trade
title_zh: 数据革命及其在国际贸易中的应用

abstract: This paper examines the mental health consequences of China’s export slowdown from 2010 to 2016. Using nationally representative individual-level panel data and a shift-share instrument for city-level export exposure, we find that export slowdown significantly increased psychological distress. The effects are most pronounced in export-reliant regions and among middle-aged, less-educated individuals, production and manufacturing workers, and married women. We further show that export slowdowns operate through both level and distributional channels: they deteriorate labor market conditions and widen income inequality. At the household level, export slowdowns increase reliance on short-term borrowing, amplifying forward-looking financial stress, particularly for families with young children. Institutional and technological forces shape these impacts: stronger local social safety nets mitigate mental distress among vulnerable groups, while accelerated workplace automation exacerbates stress for employed workers. A one-standard-deviation decline in export exposure is associated with 44,686 disability-adjusted life years (DALYs) and mental health-related costs equivalent to 0.34% of China’s GDP in 2013. These findings reveal the uneven psychological costs of adverse trade shocks and highlight the importance of distribution-sensitive trade adjustment policies.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了2010至2016年间中国出口放缓对心理健康的影响。利用具有全国代表性的个体层面面板数据及针对城市出口暴露度的转移份额工具变量，我们发现出口放缓显著加剧了心理困扰。这一效应在依赖出口的地区以及中年、受教育程度较低个体、生产与制造业工人及已婚女性中最为突出。我们进一步表明，出口放缓通过水平与分配双重渠道发挥作用：既恶化了劳动力市场状况，又扩大了收入不平等。在家庭层面，出口放缓增加了对短期借贷的依赖，加剧了前瞻性财务压力，尤其对育有幼儿的家庭影响显著。制度与技术力量塑造了这些影响：更强大的地方社会安全网缓解了弱势群体的心理困扰，而工作场所自动化的加速则加剧了在职员工的心理压力。出口暴露度每下降一个标准差，与2013年中国44，686个伤残调整生命年及相当于GDP 0.34%的心理健康相关成本相关联。这些发现揭示了不利贸易冲击带来的不均衡心理成本，并强调了注重分配效应的贸易调整政策的重要性。

title: When exports decelerate: The mental health consequences of China’s export slowdown
title_zh: 当出口减速：中国出口放缓的心理健康后果

abstract: This article proposes a graph-based maximum pairwise difference (MPD) test to compare K-sample distributions. This test can be utilized to identify the most informative variables contributing to the heterogeneity of multiple multivariate distributions. To construct the test, we first pool observations from multiple samples to create a similarity graph based on the distances between any two observations. For each observation, we next evaluate its connection probability to each sample. Then, we doubly maximize the squared differences of these connection probabilities via the within and between samples. Accordingly, the MPD test is a max-of-squares test and can effectively detect sparse alternatives. In addition, we show the asymptotic null distribution of the test statistic and establish its consistency under alternatives. To illustrate the finite sample performance of the proposed test, we conduct extensive simulation studies. The results indicate that the MPD test outperforms some commonly used multisample tests. Finally, we employ it to select relevant features related to corporate credit ratings.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种基于图的最大成对差异（MPD）检验，用于比较K个样本的分布。该检验可用于识别对多个多元分布异质性贡献最大的信息变量。为构建此检验，我们首先将多个样本的观测值合并，基于任意两个观测值之间的距离构建相似图。随后，对每个观测值，评估其与各样本的连接概率。接着，通过样本内与样本间的双重最大化，对这些连接概率的平方差进行最大化处理。因此，MPD检验是一种平方最大值检验，能有效检测稀疏备择假设。此外，我们展示了检验统计量的渐近零分布，并确立了其在备择假设下的一致性。为说明所提检验的有限样本性能，我们进行了广泛的模拟研究。结果表明，MPD检验优于一些常用的多样本检验。最后，我们将其应用于与企业信用评级相关的特征选择。
title: Graph-based multisample comparison with application to feature selection for multi-category responses
title_zh: 基于图的多样本比较及其在多类别响应特征选择中的应用

abstract: Governments increasingly use protection and targeted subsidies to promote domestic firms. These policies are usually evaluated in the market they target. This column uses India's 4G rollout to show why that can be misleading when products and infrastructure are complements. Restricting low-priced Chinese phones slowed 4G network expansion and did not raise Indian phone firms' profits, while a subsidy open to all 4G phones accelerated coverage more than a domestic-only subsidy.
abstract_zh: 各国政府日益采用保护措施和定向补贴来扶持本土企业。这些政策通常在所针对的市场中进行评估。本文利用印度4G网络的推广案例，说明当产品与基础设施为互补品时，此类评估可能产生误导。限制低价中国手机减缓了4G网络的扩展，且并未提升印度手机企业的利润，而面向所有4G手机的补贴在加速网络覆盖方面，效果优于仅限本土企业的补贴。
authors: Chirantan Chatterjee, Ying Fan, Debi Prasad Mohapatra
china_relevance_reason: 研究以印度4G推广为案例，但核心分析对象是中国低价手机及其政策影响，涉及中国产品和企业，因此与中国研究直接相关。
title: Industrial policy in complementary markets: Lessons from India's 4G rollout
title_zh: 互补市场中的产业政策：来自印度4G推广的经验教训

abstract: Housing shortages and rising rents have become a source of political pressure in many countries, prompting calls for stronger intervention in rental markets. This column shows that the effects of such intervention can outlast the policy itself: in Berlin, the 2020 rent cap was followed by continued debate over expropriation and further regulation, and the city’s price-rent ratio remained 10%–15% below trend even three years after repeal. The findings suggest that credible threats of future intervention can depress housing valuations, alter market structure, and weaken construction activity even when no regulation is currently in force.
abstract_zh: 住房短缺与租金上涨已成为多国政治压力的来源，促使人们呼吁对租赁市场进行更强有力的干预。本专栏指出，此类干预的影响可能比政策本身更为持久：在柏林，2020年的租金上限政策之后，关于征用和进一步监管的讨论持续不断，即便在政策废除三年后，该市的房价租金比仍低于趋势水平10%至15%。研究结果表明，即使当前没有实施任何监管，未来干预的可信威胁也能压低住房估值、改变市场结构，并削弱建设活动。
authors: Clemens Fuest, David Gstrein, Carla Krolage, Florian Neumeier
title: How regulatory risk and expropriation threats are affecting Berlin’s housing market
title_zh: 监管风险与征收威胁如何影响柏林住房市场
